objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a 40-year-old woman who has presented with weakness and weight loss, and interpret her laboratory findings to make a diagnosis.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’ve been feeling weaker over the last few months and I’ve also noticed I’m losing weight without changing my diet or exercise. I don’t have any urinary symptoms like pain or increased frequency, but with my family history of kidney disease I’m worried about my kidney function.
Have you noticed any changes in the color of your
I haven’t noticed any change in the color of my urine, and I’m not seeing any blood or cloudiness. I also haven’t had any burning or increased frequency.
Have you noticed any swelling in your legs, ankles,
I haven’t noticed swelling in my legs or ankles, and I don’t think I’ve had any puffiness around my face either. I mainly just feel more weak and I’ve lost weight without trying.
Can you tell me more about your family history of

My mother had kidney disease that ran in the family, and I’m not sure of the exact diagnosis—just that it progressed over time. I want to make sure my kidneys are okay because I’ve been feeling weaker and losing weight without trying.
Have you been experiencing any fevers
"No, I haven’t had any fevers. I’ve mainly just felt weaker for a few months and lost weight without trying, and I’m worried about my kidney function given my family history."
Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as

I haven’t noticed any changes in my bowel habits—no new constipation or diarrhea. I’ve also been denying fever, rash, or any other new symptoms besides the generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss.
How old are you, and do you have any other
I’m 40 years old, and I don’t have diabetes or hypertension. Other than the generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss for a few months, I haven’t noticed anything else unusual.
Have you experienced any pain in your back, sides, or
I haven’t had any pain in my back or sides. Mostly it’s just the generalized weakness and the unintentional weight loss over the last few months.
Have you noticed any nausea, vomiting, or loss of

I haven’t had any nausea or vomiting, and I haven’t noticed a loss of appetite—my main issues have been the generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss. I’m mainly concerned about my kidney function because of my family history, even though I don’t have urinary symptoms.
Have you had any night sweats or noticed any lumps or
I haven’t had night sweats, and I haven’t noticed any lumps anywhere on my body. I’ve just been feeling progressively weaker and losing weight without trying.
Have you noticed any increased thirst or that

“No, I haven’t noticed any increased thirst, and I don’t feel like I’m urinating more than usual. I’ve mainly just been getting progressively weaker and losing weight without trying. I’m concerned my kidneys could still be affected even though I’m not having urinary symptoms.”
Have you experienced any palpitations, feeling like

“I don’t have palpitations or a racing heartbeat, and I haven’t felt faint or like my heart is skipping. It’s mainly been progressive generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss over the last few months. I’m especially worried something could be going on with my kidneys given my family history.”
Have you noticed any changes in your skin color, such as

“I haven’t noticed any changes in my skin color—no yellowing or unusual paleness. I’m still mainly experiencing progressive generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss over the last few months, and my concern is whether something could be affecting my kidneys despite no urinary symptoms.”
Have you noticed any changes in your tolerance to heat

I haven’t noticed any changes in my tolerance to heat—I don’t feel unusually sweaty or heat-intolerant. It’s mainly been the progressive generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss over the last few months.
Have you had any routine blood work done recently, or have

“I haven’t had any routine blood work done recently, and I’m not sure when the last labs were. I’ve mostly just noticed the progressive weakness and unintentional weight loss, and I came in to check whether it could be related to my kidneys given my family history.”
